command: kubectl --kubeconfig=/tmp/managed-cluster-01.kubeconfig get opentelemetrycollectors -n kof -o json | jq '.items[] | {name:.metadata.name,metrics:.spec.config.exporters.prometheusremotewrite,logs:.spec.config.exporters["otlphttp/logs"],mounts:.spec.volumeMounts}'; kubectl --kubeconfig=/tmp/managed-cluster-01.kubeconfig logs deployment/kof-collectors-opencost -n kof -c kof-collectors-opencost --tail=12
